name: ChargesAccountAgentRule
text: If ChargesAccountAgent is present, then it must contain a branch of the CreditorAgent. It must not contain a completely different agent.

name: ChequeInstructionRule
text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction is optional. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Cheque), then CreditTransferTransaction/ChequeInstruction is not allowed. Rule rationale: ChequeInstructionDetails may be present if the payment method is Cheque. It must not be present if the payment method is 'Transfer'.

name: CreditorAndOrCreditorAgentRule
text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is not allowed. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Cheque) and if CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor is not present, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is mandatory. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Cheque) and if CreditTransferTransaction/Creditor is present, then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAccount is optional.

name: CreditorAgentRule
text: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque) and if CreditTransferTransaction/ ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is present and is equal to CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent) or RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAgent is mandatory. If PaymentMethod is CHK (Cheque) and if CreditTransferTransaction/ ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is not present or is not equal to CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent) or RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransaction/CreditorAgent is not allowed.

name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToDebtorGuideline

name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToCreditorGuideline

name: ChequeInstructionDeliverToCreditorAgentGuideline
